_comment: Per-release ABI oracle corrections. A key is '<family>-<date>' as it appears in
.github/config/*.json; the value names an immutable upstream tag whose ABI file
supersedes the one shipped in that tree.
Only add an entry when the tree's own oracle contradicts the code: same source
file, different crc, and a neighbouring release agrees with our build. The gate
prints every override it applies, so nothing here can hide silently.
android12-5.10-2023-09: ashmem.c is byte-identical to 2023-11's, but this tree's
abi_gki_aarch64.xml lists is_ashmem_file as 0x4bef6e5f while ours (and 2023-11's
oracle) say 0x94fc40b5 - the file was never regenerated on that retired branch.

android12-5.10-2023-09.why: is_ashmem_file crc never regenerated; 2023-11 carries the corrected value
